bullets.text: Privacy-Focused Friend Finder - **Bluesky** introduces a secure way to connect with friends without spam invites.
Age Verification for Nude Photos - The UK government pushes **Apple** and **Google** to block nude images without age checks.
Apple's iOS 26.3 Beta - New features simplify switching from iPhone to **Android**, enhancing user flexibility.
AirPods Live Translation Expansion - **Apple** extends its Live Translation feature to more EU users with iOS 26.2.
YouTube's Oscars Streaming Deal - **YouTube** secures exclusive rights to stream the Oscars starting in 2029.
Cisco's Zero-Day Vulnerability Alert - **Cisco** warns of a critical exploit affecting its products with no patches available.
Meta's Community Expansion - **Threads** adds over 200 communities, enhancing user engagement with new interest topics.
Rad Power Bikes Bankruptcy - **Rad Power Bikes** files for bankruptcy, seeking to sell the business amid financial struggles.
Amazon's New AI Organization - **Amazon** appoints Peter DeSantis to lead a new AI-focused division within the company.
Adobe Faces Class-Action Lawsuit - **Adobe** is accused of misusing authors' works for AI training in a new lawsuit.
